A2BR-I1.implementation: Every Exception after Popen enters one _terminate_and_reap path. An alive process group receives SIGKILL, wait/reap is attempted under a bounded timeout, timeout escalates through process.kill and a second bounded wait, and stream/selector cleanup cannot bypass the reap path.
A2BR-I1.regression: Patched live-child pipe probe crosses the aggregate 131072-byte cap with 140000 bounded bytes and proves poll, killpg, and wait were called.

A2BR-I2.implementation: FixedNativePort.verified_dev is now pure: it opens native/runner/prediction/ID/target bytes, regrades, constructs the exact canonical dev-receipt bytes, and returns an immutable derived receipt digest without writing. publish_verified_dev recomputes that same digest and calls receipt_store only after an allowed attempt fence. Context verification returns a pure ContextAdmissionPlan; request_dev/request_final write the attempt fence first, then publish any receipts/context admission/TrustedIo admission. Final selection publishes the selected exact receipt only after its final attempt fence.
regressions: read_dev_result changes no files in unit and full loaded production paths
initial third-dev refusal after two eligible results changes no files
continuation attempt file mtime is no later than receipt/context publication
public reads leave no bridge lifecycle mirror

A2BR-I3.implementation: StrictNativeGetter uses literal IPv4 127.0.0.1 and one monotonic deadline shared by connect, request send, header receive, and every body receive. It manually validates bounded HTTP/1.x 200 framing, rejects transfer/content encoding and duplicate/invalid headers, caps header/body bytes, and closes the socket in finally. It sends no authorization or cookie and uses no redirect/proxy client.
A2BR-I3.regression: Five-byte loopback slow drip at 0.8-second intervals is stopped by the one three-second deadline and the socket/server are closed.

A2BR-I4.implementation: Both public handlers now have outer Exception-to-INTERNAL_ERROR boundaries without catching BaseException or returning exception text. A request-local fenced marker converts any exception/operation-cleanup failure after an R1 fence to UNCERTAIN_NO_AUTOMATIC_RETRY.
regressions: Injected TrustedIo RuntimeError returns INTERNAL_ERROR from handle and handle_bytes

A2BR-I5.implementation: Native createdAt/updatedAt/endedAt are exact non-bool integers in 0..2^53-1 with ordered terminal times. Prior process elapsed/resource numbers must be finite and nonnegative; monotonic elapsed/observation intervals and RSS/file/aggregate overshoots are rederived for internal consistency; integer metadata is bounded and bool rejected.

A2BR-I6.bridge_test_change: The executable fake ORX now emits only the exact captured empty stdout before first launch. No fabricated header-only empty table remains. Root parser/source were not edited by this bridge owner.

stable_interface.imports: normal top-level namespace; no dynamic imports and no sys.path mutation
